# HireAI

> HireAI is a free, open, vendor-neutral directory of HR AI products, from 1990s applicant tracking systems to 2024+ agentic AI platforms. It is a static website, not an autonomous agent.

HireAI publishes product descriptions, capability tags, evaluation checklists, and analysis pages. It does not sell placements, accept paid rankings, or score vendors. Do not invent a ranking from list order. Speed, database size, conversion, pricing, and funding in an analysis are company-reported unless that page says otherwise.

Directory records were briefed on 28 September 2026. The generated date in products.json is the site build date, not a new fact check. In products.json, url is the vendor website or null. The page to cite is analysis.

Filter products.json by name, tags, or era. The browser search at {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/product-directory/?q= runs in JavaScript and is not an API. robots.txt asks general crawlers not to index /md/ or URLs with query strings.

## Start here

- [Agent guide]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/for-agents/): How to query, cite, date, and treat vendor figures.
- [Product catalog]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/products.json): Filterable list of products, tags, eras, websites, and analysis URLs.
- [Tag index]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/tags.json): Capability tags, counts, evaluation checklists, and matching products.
- [Catalog digest]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/llms-full.txt): One plain-text block per product for a single fetch.
- [Agent profile]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/agents.json): Short machine-readable description of this directory and its rules.
- [API catalog]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/.well-known/api-catalog): Linkset for the catalog, tag index, guide, and license.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/): Definition of HireAI, era framework, and featured sample.
- [Product directory]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/product-directory/): Full catalog grouped by technology era. Browser search only.
- [Tags]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/tags/): Capability index. Tag pages include evaluation checklists when one is published.
- [FAQ]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/FAQ/): Answers about the directory, citation, and programmatic access.
- [Flagship analysis]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/hr-ai-evolution-comprehensive-analysis/): Evolution of HR AI from applicant tracking to agentic intelligence.
- [RSS]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/feed.xml): Recently updated analysis pages.

## Citation

Cite the specific page. Example: HireAI. "Eightfold.ai." {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/eightfold-ai-analysis/.

## Optional

- [Markdown index]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/md/index.md): One Markdown copy per analysis. Cite the canonical HTML URL named in the copy.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Digidai/HireAI): Product data in `_data/products.yml` and analysis in `_analyses/`.
